items.prompt: Kiki has 20 sweets and eats one fifth of them. Build a part-whole model with 5 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: One fifth means the whole is cut into 5 equal units.
Eaten is 1 unit and left is the other 4 units.
items.explanation: 20 divided by 5 is 4, so one unit is 4 sweets. Kiki eats 1 unit and has 4 units left.

items.prompt: There are 18 children in a class and one third wear glasses. Build a part-whole model with 3 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: One third means 3 equal units in the whole.
Glasses is 1 unit and no glasses is the other 2 units.
items.explanation: 18 divided by 3 is 6, so one unit is 6 children. Glasses is 1 unit and no glasses is 2 units.

items.prompt: A jar holds 24 coins and three quarters are silver. Build a part-whole model with 4 equal units and say what one unit is worth.
hints: Quarters mean 4 equal units in the whole.
Silver is 3 units and the other coins are 1 unit.
items.explanation: 24 divided by 4 is 6, so one unit is 6 coins. Silver is 3 units, which is 18 coins.
